concerns.text: FR-003 and Plan.md explicitly mandate computing Shannon, Simpson, AND Observed OTUs indices. T020a only mentions 'Shannon, Simpson, Observed OTUs' in the description but T020b focuses solely on 'alpha-diversity calculation' without explicitly ensuring all three indices are computed. More critically, the Plan.md Risk Mitigation section mandates a 'rarefaction/normalization step' to prevent sequencing depth artifacts, yet no task in the main execution flow (Phase 3/4) implements this rarefaction logic. T043 exists in 'New Tasks' but is not integrated into the dependency graph, meaning the core statistical requirement (FR-003) is implemented without the necessary normalization step defined in the plan.

FR-004 requires performing Spearman rank correlation tests between EACH alpha-diversity index (Shannon, Simpson, Observed OTUs) and sleep variables. T021 states 'Implement Spearman rank correlation test' but does not explicitly mandate iterating over all three diversity indices. If T021 only implements correlation for one index (e.g., Shannon), it fails to satisfy FR-004's requirement to test 'each' index, constituting a silent weakening of the statistical scope.

FR-006 and US-3 require generating a 'summary table of all correlations' as part of the final report. T029a saves a CSV to `correlation_summary.csv`, but the spec's Edge Cases and US-3 acceptance criteria imply a human-readable report (Markdown/HTML/PDF) stating findings (e.g., 'No significant associations found'). The task list lacks a dedicated task to generate this final human-readable report artifact, leaving the 'Reporting' deliverable of US-3 incomplete and the 'No significant associations' edge case handling (FR-006) potentially unverified in a user-facing format.

The Plan.md establishes a strict 'fail-fast' Data Feasibility Check as a blocking gate. T012c implements this check. However, T040 (in 'New Tasks') duplicates this logic with a 'robust data source verification' function. Having two separate tasks for the same critical gate creates ambiguity about which one executes the block, risking a split in the 'fail-fast' logic required by the plan. If T040 is not explicitly integrated as a prerequisite to T012c or replaces it, the pipeline may bypass the strict verification if T012c passes but T040 is skipped, violating the plan's conditional execution flow.

SC-005 requires measuring reproducibility by re-executing the pipeline and comparing SHA-256 hashes. T035 is marked 'BLOCKED UNTIL T030 PASSES' (plot generation). If the project remains in the 'BLOCKED' state (no data found), T030 cannot pass, and thus T035 cannot run. This creates a logical dead-end where the reproducibility success criterion (SC-005) has no valid execution path to be measured in the blocked scenario, violating the plan's requirement to handle the 'Data Availability Gap' gracefully while still validating the pipeline's structure.
